name: fantasy
note: Rules for the /adventure character creator. Editable data, not code: a setting can ship its own. Lives inside src/ because the deploy rsyncs src/ only.

races.name: Human
races.blurb: Adaptable, ambitious, everywhere. Good at all of it, best at none.

races.name: Elf
races.blurb: Quick and long-lived. Elves see the shot coming and step aside.

races.name: Dwarf
races.blurb: Stout, stubborn, and hard to kill. Dwarves remember every slight.

races.name: Halfling
races.blurb: Small, lucky, and hard to notice. Charm first, quick feet after.

races.name: Orc
races.blurb: Built for the front line. Hits first, hits hard, thinks later.

races.name: Tiefling
races.blurb: Horned and unwelcome anywhere. Talks its way in, then out again.

races.name: Catfolk
races.blurb: Sleek, proud, and curious. Lands well, never admits it fell.

races.name: Lizardfolk
races.blurb: Cold-blooded and patient. Thick scales, and a longer memory.

races.name: Birdfolk
races.blurb: Hollow-boned and sharp-eyed. Sees the whole map from above.

races.name: Kobold
races.blurb: Small, clever, and never alone. Wins by trap, not by arm.

classes.name: Fighter
classes.blurb: Stand in front. Armor, steel, and the nerve to hold the line.

classes.name: Rogue
classes.blurb: Locks, pockets, and shadows. Strike once, from the wrong side.

classes.name: Cleric
classes.blurb: Faith with a mace in hand. Mend the party, ward off the dark.

classes.name: Wizard
classes.blurb: Fragile and dangerous. Read everything, then rewrite the fight.

classes.name: Ranger
classes.blurb: Tracks, traps, and bows. At home where the roads give out.

classes.name: Bard
classes.blurb: Song, talk, and nerve. Wins the fights that never quite start.

classes.name: Wanderer
classes.note: Always available - nobody should be locked out by bad dice.
classes.blurb: No training, no calling, no excuses. Learns it on the road.

items.name: Longsword
items.blurb: a soldier's blade, plain and reliable

items.name: Battleaxe
items.blurb: heavy work; splits shield and bone

items.name: Greatsword
items.blurb: two hands, one swing, no second try

items.name: Spear
items.blurb: cheap, long, keeps things at a distance

items.name: Mace
items.blurb: no edge to keep, no edge to lose

items.name: Rapier
items.blurb: a duelist's needle, fast off the draw

items.name: Quarterstaff
items.blurb: walking stick, roof prop, and cudgel

items.name: Dagger
items.blurb: small, quiet, never out of reach

items.name: Shortbow
items.blurb: quiet range and twenty good arrows

items.name: Longbow
items.blurb: reaches farther than they expect

items.name: Hand Crossbow
items.blurb: fits under a cloak, loads slowly

items.name: Leather Jerkin
items.blurb: boiled hide, better than a good shirt

items.name: Chain Shirt
items.blurb: rings enough to turn a knife

items.name: Plate Harness
items.blurb: an iron room you walk around in

items.name: Wooden Shield
items.blurb: banded oak, and a fair sled downhill

items.name: Padded Robes
items.blurb: quilted, warm, and it does not jingle

items.name: Holy Symbol
items.blurb: a token your god has been known to see

items.name: Wizard's Staff
items.blurb: chalked with sigils and faintly warm

items.name: Component Pouch
items.blurb: chalk, guano, and one dried newt

items.name: Talisman
items.blurb: carved bone that hums near old magic

items.name: Lute
items.blurb: six strings, one cracked, still true

items.name: Thieves' Tools
items.blurb: picks, wedges, and a very thin wire

items.name: Grappling Hook
items.blurb: iron claw; bring your own rope

items.name: Rope, 50 Feet
items.blurb: hemp, and the answer to most problems

items.name: Torches
items.blurb: six of them, four hours of light each

items.name: Lantern
items.blurb: steady light that survives the wind

items.name: Tinderbox
items.blurb: flint, steel, and a scrap of charcloth

items.name: Rations
items.blurb: a week of hard bread and salt pork

items.name: Waterskin
items.blurb: two days of water if you are careful

items.name: Bedroll
items.blurb: canvas and wool; sleep is a resource

items.name: Healing Draught
items.blurb: one swallow closes what should not

items.name: Ink and Parchment
items.blurb: for maps, notes, and forged writs
